description:
I'm looking for people who are passionate about science and technology, eager to innovate in their fields of knowledge, challenge conventional thinking, and explore new ways of understanding the world.

It doesn't matter how much you know or how experienced you are. What truly matters is your full commitment, enthusiasm, and willingness to be part of a one-of-a-kind experience

And remember, it won't all be about work! I want this team to be a safe and welcoming space where you can be yourself
